title: Revisions to Road Usage Charges and COE System with New Island-wide ERP System
what_it_is: Revisions to Road Usage Charges and COE System with New Island-wide ERP System

sections.label: Distance-based congestion pricing technology
sections.summary: The new system's technology enables congestion pricing based on distance travelled, charging motorists who travel a full congested road more than those travelling part of it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The technology of the new system will allow us to implement this congestion pricing on a distance-travelled basis, which will be fairer to motorists.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: For example, motorists who travel the full stretch of a congested road can be charged more than those who travel, say, only a part of it.
